title: Vampire Vape Tropical Pineapple Dream E-Liquid Shortfill 50ml
description: Pineapple Dream 50ml Shortfill from Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection delivers a softly sweet tropical blend of Pawpaw and Pineapple for sub-ohm vaping. Pawpaw adds a custard-like body with a mix of Banana, Mango and Melon flavour notes, while Pineapple adds lift with its sweet-tart freshness. The two combine into a velvety tropical flavour with enough contrast to keep it bright and engaging. Blended at 70VG/30PG, this shortfill is ideal for DTL (direct-to-lung) vaping with sub-ohm devices. Add a 10ml nicotine shot to tailor the strength to your preference. Vampire Vape e-liquids are made in the UK and trusted by vapers for their quality and flavour consistency. The Tropical range adds new fruit combinations to their award-winning lineup. Also available in Nic Salt, Freebase and Concentrate formats.
